title: Progress Bars
content: Build progress bar components with multiple variants. Basic structure: track (bg-gray-200 rounded-full h-2), fill (bg-blue-600 rounded-full). Value display: percentage text to the right. Label: progress title above bar. Colors: different colors for status (green=complete, yellow=warning, red=critical). Animated fill: transition-all duration-500. Accessibility: role="progressbar" with aria attributes.

variants.simple: Create progress bars showing completion percentage with labels.
variants.detailed: Build progress bar components with multiple variants. Basic structure: track (bg-gray-200 rounded-full h-2), fill (bg-blue-600 rounded-full). Value display: percentage text to the right. Label: progress title above bar. Colors: different colors for status (green=complete, yellow=warning, red=critical). Animated fill: transition-all duration-500. Accessibility: role="progressbar" with aria attributes.
variants.advanced: Build progress bar components with multiple variants and accessibility. Basic structure: track container (bg-gray-200 rounded-full), fill bar (rounded-full) positioned inside with width based on percentage. Value display: percentage text (text-sm font-medium) to the right, inside bar for thick variants, or as tooltip. Label: progress title (font-medium) above bar with optional subtitle. Size variants: thin (h-1), medium (h-2), thick (h-4 with text inside), with segments. Colors: contextual colors for status - green (bg-green-500) for complete/success, blue (bg-blue-500) for in-progress, yellow/amber (bg-amber-500) for warning, red (bg-red-500) for critical/error. Animated fill: transition-all duration-500 ease-out on width change for smooth animation. Striped pattern: CSS repeating-linear-gradient (45deg stripes) for active/processing state, animate stripe movement with CSS animation. Indeterminate: animated gradient or stripe movement for unknown progress duration, no percentage shown. Circular progress: ring-based alternative using SVG circle with stroke-dasharray and stroke-dashoffset, rotation animation, value in center. Multi-segment: different colored segments in one bar representing breakdown (e.g., 40% complete, 30% in-progress, 30% pending). Goal indicator: vertical marker line showing target position on track. Stacked progress bars: multiple bars in column for comparison with aligned labels. Buffer progress: secondary lighter fill showing buffered amount (like video loading). Accessibility: role="progressbar", aria-valuenow={value}, aria-valuemin={0}, aria-valuemax={100}, aria-label describing what progress represents. Dark mode: adjust track color (dark:bg-gray-700). Component API: value, max, label, color, size, showValue, animated, indeterminate props.
